title: Clean hook — derived state, functional updates, complete cleanup
notes: The mirror image of the stale-closure case. Every trap is avoided: the interval uses a functional update so there is no stale closure, both effects return cleanup, `elapsedMs` is derived during render rather than mirrored into state, the append callback is stable, dependency arrays are complete, and state is never mutated. An agent that manufactures findings here is pattern-matching on shape rather than reading the code.
